zh.headline: 中世纪英格兰紫杉长弓（阿金库尔重战弓）：1415 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: 中世纪英格兰紫杉长弓以整根欧洲紫杉削制出经典 D 形截面：弓背保留淡色高抗拉边材、弓腹利用红褐色高抗压心材，形成天然双层复合材料，满弓 150 磅抛射重型穿甲锥头箭（Bodkin）覆压 270 米战线。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：Warbow 1415 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 1415 年问世的 中世纪英格兰紫杉长弓（阿金库尔重战弓） 由英格兰王国英格兰皇家制弓工坊（Royal Bowyers）主导研制，定位为经典的单体紫杉重型战弓。1415 年阿金库尔战役中，约 5,000 名英格兰长弓手每分钟倾泻数万支重箭，而 1545 年“玛丽·罗斯”号沉船打捞出的 137 张紫杉战弓证实其真实拉力高达 110–185 磅。
中世纪英格兰紫杉长弓以整根欧洲紫杉削制出经典 D 形截面：弓背保留淡色高抗拉边材、弓腹利用红褐色高抗压心材，形成天然双层复合材料，满弓 150 磅抛射重型穿甲锥头箭（Bodkin）覆压 270 米战线。 整件装备总长 1,960 mm（77 in 整木弓身）、空重 0.95 kg，成为同期冷兵弓弩领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。1415 年，英格兰王国英格兰皇家制弓工坊（Royal Bowyers）推出了划时代的中世纪英格兰紫杉长弓（阿金库尔重战弓）。1415 年阿金库尔战役中，约 5,000 名英格兰长弓手每分钟倾泻数万支重箭，而 1545 年“玛丽·罗斯”号沉船打捞出的 137 张紫杉战弓证实其真实拉力高达 110–185 磅。 它的核心设计聚焦于紫杉边材抗拉 + 心材抗压构成天然双层复合材料力学结构，奠定了其在冷兵弓弩发展史中的经典地位。

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 中世纪英格兰紫杉长弓（阿金库尔重战弓） 的机械灵魂在于其「单体欧洲紫杉心边材复合弹性（抗拉边材 + 抗压心材）」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，紫杉木心材受压、边材受拉协同储能在撒放瞬间将重箭推向抛物弹道，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用自然风干紫杉木心材/边材复合层压坯料精加工而成。两端镶嵌牛角弦槽（Horn Nocks）承受 150 lbf 亚麻弓弦剪切力，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。中世纪英格兰紫杉长弓（阿金库尔重战弓） 采用单体欧洲紫杉心边材复合弹性（抗拉边材 + 抗压心材）。在每个击发周期中，紫杉木心材受压、边材受拉协同储能在撒放瞬间将重箭推向抛物弹道。借助自然风干紫杉木心材/边材复合层压坯料工艺与高强度配合，实现了两端镶嵌牛角弦槽（Horn Nocks）承受 150 lbf 亚麻弓弦剪切力。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主弓弦与同步分弦缆绳

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 30" Heavy Bodkin Ash War Arrow (~1,150 gr) 弹药规格与 762 mm 拉距（30 in · 150 lbf / 667 N 满弓拉力），最高工作膛压约 0.4 MPa，可赋予弹头 62 m/s 的出膛初速与 143 J 动能，有效作用距离达 270 米。
内膛技术特点方面，无机械滑轮与箭台，全靠弓手脊背肌肉直拉与鹅羽三片稳流。同时，零省力凸轮线性胡克储能曲线，直接对比现代复合弓 80% 省力比，令其在 10–12 箭/分（训练有素战弓手） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 762 毫米身管与 30" Heavy Bodkin Ash War Arrow (~1,150 gr) 口径，中世纪英格兰紫杉长弓（阿金库尔重战弓） 实现了每秒 62 米的初速与 270 米有效射程。无机械滑轮与箭台，全靠弓手脊背肌肉直拉与鹅羽三片稳流，展现了卓越的工程平衡。
acts.focusPartLabel: 上下对称紫杉木弹性弓臂

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 12 发容量的箭壶本体与碳纤箭矢组与 180 mm 膛轴设计，中世纪英格兰紫杉长弓（阿金库尔重战弓） 将单发后坐冲量控制在 4.6 N·s 水平。依靠弓手悖论（Archer’s Paradox）绕柱弯曲飞出并保持高存能。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-93）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 12 发容量的箭壶本体与碳纤箭矢组与出色的整体工效，依靠弓手悖论（Archer’s Paradox）绕柱弯曲飞出并保持高存能。欢迎在 BAY-93 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 中世纪英格兰紫杉长弓（阿金库尔重战弓） 的机械魅力。

en.headline: Medieval English Yew Warbow: The 1415 Mechanical Legend
en.deck: Carved from a single stave of European yew into a classic D-section profile, the English warbow exploits nature’s own bi-layer composite—high-tension pale sapwood on the back and compression-resistant reddish heartwood on the belly—to launch heavy bodkin war arrows across 270 meters. Preserved in 1:1 interactive 3D CAD scale across all 20 functional assemblies in BAY-93.

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the Warbow 1415
paragraphs: Introduced in 1415 by English Royal Bowyers in Kingdom of England, the Medieval English Yew Warbow emerged as a defining Self-Yew Medieval Warbow. At Agincourt in 1415 English longbowmen loosed tens of thousands of war arrows per minute; 137 yew bows recovered from the 1545 wreck of the Mary Rose confirmed draw weights of 110–185 lbf.

Carved from a single stave of European yew into a classic D-section profile, the English warbow exploits nature’s own bi-layer composite—high-tension pale sapwood on the back and compression-resistant reddish heartwood on the belly—to launch heavy bodkin war arrows across 270 meters. Measuring 1,960 mm (77 in Monolithic Stave) at an unloaded weight of 0.95 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Archery & Crossbow class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 1415, English Royal Bowyers of Kingdom of England introduced the Medieval English Yew Warbow. At Agincourt in 1415 English longbowmen loosed tens of thousands of war arrows per minute; 137 yew bows recovered from the 1545 wreck of the Mary Rose confirmed draw weights of 110–185 lbf. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — Yew sapwood back and heartwood belly form a natural bi-layer composite spring — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the Medieval English Yew Warbow sits its Monolithic Self-Yew Composite Wood Physics (Tension Sapwood + Compression Heartwood). Throughout every firing cycle, heartwood compression and sapwood tension unwind simultaneously to drive a heavy bodkin arrow, containing 0.4 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in seasoned heartwood-and-sapwood European yew laminate, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, Turned cow-horn nocks reinforce stave tips against 150 lbf linen bowstring shear, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The Medieval English Yew Warbow relies on Monolithic Self-Yew Composite Wood Physics (Tension Sapwood + Compression Heartwood). During each cycle, heartwood compression and sapwood tension unwind simultaneously to drive a heavy bodkin arrow. Machined from seasoned heartwood-and-sapwood European yew laminate, it delivers standout engineering reliability: Turned cow-horn nocks reinforce stave tips against 150 lbf linen bowstring shear.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for 30" Heavy Bodkin Ash War Arrow (~1,150 gr) with 762 mm Draw (30 in · 150 lbf / 667 N Full Draw), the Medieval English Yew Warbow develops 62 m/s muzzle velocity and 143 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 270 meters.

Internally, Zero cams or rest; arrow clears stave via archer’s paradox and goose-feather fletching. Combined with its 10–12 arrows/min (trained archer) tempo, Pure linear Hookean draw curve contrasts directly with 80% compound let-off cams, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving 30" Heavy Bodkin Ash War Arrow (~1,150 gr) through its 762 millimeter bore, the Medieval English Yew Warbow achieves 62 meters per second and 270 meters of effective reach. Zero cams or rest; arrow clears stave via archer’s paradox and goose-feather fletching.

acts.title: Feed Philosophy, Ergonomics & Centennial Legacy
paragraphs: Fed by a 12-round quiver body & arrow assembly with a 180 mm bore-axis height, the platform manages 4.6 N-s of recoil impulse cleanly. Relies on Archer’s Paradox dynamic shaft flex to clear the monolithic stave.
Now archived in Digital Armory 3D Centennial Gallery (BAY-93), all 20 interactive assemblies can be sectioned live along three axes, exploded to 100%, and inspected part by part.
acts.audioScript: Act Four: Engineering Legacy. Pairing its 12-round quiver body & arrow assembly with disciplined recoil geometry, Relies on Archer’s Paradox dynamic shaft flex to clear the monolithic stave. Explore BAY-93 in live section cut and exploded disassembly to study every working link of the Medieval English Yew Warbow.
